title: Velo Client 0.9.7: the new launcher & in-game menus
summary: A completely redesigned launcher and in-game menus: a new Home, Library, Store with daily picks, bundles, gifts and wishlists, a Locker for every cosmetic, a new title screen and pause menu, invite rewards and a guided first start.

blocks.text: 0.9.7 rebuilds the launcher from the ground up. Every page has a new look, the navigation moved to the top, and the Play button now lives in a bar at the bottom that's always within reach.
**Home** shows what you played last with one big Continue button, what's new, and your recent profiles under **Jump back in**. All your profiles moved to the new **Library**, with search and filters.

items: **Launch bar** at the bottom: pick a profile or server, see its status and press Play from any page.
**Search everything** with **Ctrl + K**: pages, profiles, servers, settings and store items.
**Notifications** in the bell: friend requests, messages, updates and new posts.
Tabs at the top now have a smooth sliding underline, and every popup (new profile, add server, confirmations) got a new rounded look.

blocks.caption: Featured collection, daily picks and more

items: **Daily picks**: four items every day, two of them on sale.
**Bundles**: whole sets for less. If you already own part of one, you only pay for the rest.
**Gifts**: buy any item for a friend, and it goes straight to their Locker.
**Wishlist**: keep track of what you want next.
**Rarity tiers** on every item, and a bigger page for each one with a live 3D preview on your own skin.

blocks.caption: Every item has its own page

blocks.text: Everything you own in one place: wings, capes, auras **and your skins**. The skin changer moved here from the profile page. Save **loadouts** to switch between full looks in one click.

Every player now has an **invite code**. When a friend enters it and plays for 2 hours, **they get 300 Velo Coins and so do you**. The more friends you invite, the more each one pays: 300, then 400, then 500 coins per friend, for up to 10 friends.

blocks.caption: Your code, the reward ladder and your invites

blocks.text: New to Velo Client? Enter your friend's code during setup, or later under Invite friends. You can enter one in your first 7 days.
New players are walked through setup: sign in, bring keybinds, servers and mods over from another client, and enter a friend's code. Every step can be skipped.
The profile page was rebuilt: play time, sessions, most played profiles, what you're wearing, your connected accounts and stats from your singleplayer worlds.

items: **Servers** are cards with live status, players online and ping.
**Clips** can now be **trimmed**: set a start and an end and save the part you want as a new clip.
**Settings** has a side menu and a search box.
**Custom themes** are still yours to make: pick colors, corners and animation speed with a live preview, and **share a theme as a code** others can paste in.

blocks.text: The in-game menus got the redesign too. The **title screen** has a *Jump back in* card for your last server, big menu words that slide on hover and your friends online at the bottom. The **pause menu** shows the server you're on, your quick toggles and a one-press clip button - and both open with a smooth slide-in.

**Store, Locker and Friends** in game now look exactly like the launcher: tabs in the header, the same cards and the same fonts, drawn crisp at any GUI scale. The Locker shows what you wear per slot, a big live preview and your whole collection - with each pair of wings' settings right below.

items: New **Statistics**, **Advancements** and **Keybinds** screens (with a keyboard map of your binds).
Mods like **Essential**, Mod Menu and ukulib keep their buttons - they're fitted into the new menus.
Loadouts in the launcher now remember each cosmetic's **colours and settings**.
Your **wishlist** has its own page in the Store, with what everything costs together.
A **Relaunch** button restarts your profile in one press after changing mods.

blocks.text: Tell us what you think in the Discord!
